examples.ko: 하늘에 구름이 많아요. 곧 비가 올 것 같아요.
examples.en: There are a lot of clouds in the sky. It looks like it'll rain soon.
There are no clouds, so you can see the stars clearly.
I can't see the sun because of the clouds.
The clouds are hanging low over the mountain.
A little sunshine shows through the clouds.

explain: 구름이 많아지는 것을 “구름이 끼다”라고 해요. “구름이 껴서 흐려요”처럼 써요.
explain_en: When clouds gather, Korean says 구름이 끼다. For example: 구름이 껴서 흐려요 (“it's cloudy because clouds have gathered”).

examples.en: I change into my swimsuit at the pool.
I didn't bring a swimsuit, so I bought one.

examples.ko: 바다에 갈 때 수영복 위에 티셔츠를 입어요.
examples.en: When I go to the sea, I wear a T-shirt over my swimsuit.

examples.ko: 수영복을 입고 수영모도 꼭 써야 해요.
examples.en: You must put on a swimsuit and also a swim cap.
I ordered my child's swimsuit online.

explain: 옷이라서 '입다'와 같이 써요. 갈아입을 때는 '갈아입다'를 써요. 수영할 때 같이 챙기는 것으로 '수영모', '물안경'이 있어요.
explain_en: As clothing, it goes with '입다' (to wear), and '갈아입다' for changing into it. Other things you bring for swimming include '수영모' (swim cap) and '물안경' (goggles).
